source: Calibrated Oct 2026 against GoMechanic Hyderabad. GoMechanic's public pages (gomechanic.in/hyderabad/car-repair/<brand-model>) embed only a per-brand list of entry-level periodic-service 'from' prices for each model+fuel (treated here as Basic); Standard/Comprehensive prices load only after picking a car in their client-side app, so they could not be read. BASIC prices sit at GoMechanic's entry level (Hatchback petrol 2,199; Luxury a little under their BMW 13,399-13,599). STANDARD (~1.5x Basic) and PREMIUM (~2.2-2.4x Basic, comparable to GoMechanic's Comprehensive) are estimates from typical 2025-26 Hyderabad multi-brand workshop pricing. Electric skips engine oil/filters and is cheapest; Luxury CNG is listed for completeness only. All prices are whole INR covering labour and the listed consumables; extra parts found during service are quoted separately.
